name: Kesar Enterprises Limited
about: Kesar Enterprises Limited engages in the production and sale of sugar, spirits, and ethanol in India. It operates through Sugar, Power, and Spirits segments. The company manufactures and sells rectified spirit, neutral alcohol, alcoholic beverages, and byproducts of sugar. It also operates a bagasse-based co-generation power plant. The company was formerly known as The Kesar Sugar Works Limited. Kesar Enterprises Limited was founded in 1932 and is based in Mumbai, India.
